title: narcissus serotinus var. genuinus
intro: Narcissus serotinus var. genuinus, commonly known as Autumn-flowering Daffodil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Narcissus serotinus var. genuinus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and glycosides, which have been shown to possess analgesic, anti-asthmatic, and expectorant properties.
